build.beforeDevCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const cp=require('child_process');const path=require('path');function findPrefix(){const roots=[];let dir=process.cwd();for(let i=0;i<8;i++){roots.push(dir);const parent=path.dirname(dir);if(parent===dir)break;dir=parent;}const rels=['frontend','.',path.join('crates','gestura-gui','frontend'),path.join('gestura-gui','frontend')];for(const root of roots){for(const rel of rels){const p=path.resolve(root,rel);if(fs.existsSync(path.join(p,'package.json')))return p;}}return null;}const prefix=findPrefix();if(!prefix){console.error('Could not locate frontend package.json. cwd=',process.cwd());process.exit(1);}const npm=process.platform==='win32'?'npm.cmd':'npm';const child=cp.spawn(npm,['--prefix',prefix,'run','dev'],{stdio:'inherit',detached:true});function forward(sig){try{process.kill(-child.pid,sig);}catch(_e){}try{child.kill(sig);}catch(_e){}}['SIGINT','SIGTERM','SIGHUP'].forEach((sig)=>process.on(sig,()=>{forward(sig);}));child.on('exit',(code,_signal)=>process.exit(code??1));"
